stepTitle: There is a unique optimal solution to Milad's model.
stepBody:
Milad creates a DataFrame called features and a Series called target using the code snippet below. Assume that there is no value in genre called "genre".

from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
target $$=$$ $$song_{sample["streams"]}$$
features $$=$$ song_sample[["genre"]]

for $$curr_g$$ in features["genre"].unique():
$$features[curr_g]$$ $$=$$ (features["genre"] $$==$$ curr_g).astype(int)

features $$=$$ features.drop("genre", $$axis=1)$$

model $$=$$ LinearRegression(fit_intercept=False)
model.fit(features, target)

(i) Which of the following statements are true for this model? Select all that apply.
